planets.name: LHS 1678 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 1678 with a 4.97-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: LHS 1678 d was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around LHS 1678. Its orbit and size follow Silverstein et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
